description_en: Queries the information about URL-based upload jobs
description_zh: 调用GetURLUploadInfos获取URL上传信息，适用于通过URL上传文件的场景，用于查询上传任务的详细信息
name: GetUrlUploadInfos

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the upload jobs. You can specify one or more job IDs. You can obtain the job IDs from the response parameter JobId of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86311.html operation.

You can specify a maximum of 10 job IDs.

Separate the job IDs with commas (,).

You must specify either JobIds or UploadURLs. If you specify both parameters, only the value of JobIds takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
上传任务ID（JobId）列表。由一个或多个JobId组成，JobId为通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86311.html接口上传时，返回参数JobId的值。
最多支持10个ID。
多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

JobIds和UploadURLs必须指定一个，二者同时传入时只处理JobIds
parameters.name: job_ids

parameters.help_en:
The upload URLs of the source files. You can specify a maximum of 10 URLs. Separate the URLs with commas (,).



The URLs must be encoded.

If a media file is uploaded multiple times, we recommend that you specify the URL of the media file only once in this parameter.

You must specify either JobIds or UploadURLs. If you specify both parameters, only the value of JobIds takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
上传视频源文件URL列表。多个URL之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持10个。
使用前，先进行URL编码。
如果同一URL视频多次上传，建议传入单个URL进行查询。
JobIds和UploadURLs必须指定一个，二者同时传入时只处理JobIds
parameters.name: upload_urls

NonExists.description_en: The job IDs or upload URLs that do not exist

items.description_en:
The job ID or upload URL that does not exist.

Job IDs are returned for this parameter if you have specified JobIds in the request, and upload URLs are returned if you have specified UploadURLs in the request
items.description_zh:
不存在的JobId或URL列表。

如果请求参数为JobIds，返回值为JobId；
如果请求参数为UploadURLs，返回值为URL

URLUploadInfoList.description_en: The details about URL-based upload jobs

items.description_en: The information about the URL-based upload job. For more information, see the "URLUploadInfo: the information about a URL-based upload job" section of the "Basic data types" topic
items.description_zh: URL上传信息列表。具体上传名称及描述，请参见URLUploadInfo：URL上传信息

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the upload job was complete. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the upload job was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the upload job failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the upload job failed

JobId.description_en: The ID of the upload job

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the uploaded media file

Status.description_en: The status of the upload job. For more information about the valid values of the parameter, see the "Status: the status of a URL-based upload job" section of the [Basic data types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html） topic
Status.description_zh: URL拉取任务状态。具体的拉取状态取值及说明，请参见[Status：URL上传任务状态]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html）

UploadURL.description_en:
The upload URL of the source file.

A maximum of 100 URLs can be returned
UploadURL.description_zh:
上传视频源文件URL。

最多可以返回100条记录

UserData.description_en: The user data. The value is a JSON string
